ko: 죽음에서 날 살리신 주 성령 놀라우신 주 하나님
en: Lord, You know me better than I know myself
Where could I go, away from Your presence?

ko: 할렐루야 주의 나라가 (눈먼 자는 눈을 뜨며)
en: Hellelujah, let your kingdome come (Let the blind see, let the deaf hear) (Let the lame man leap like a deer)
Jesus, we acciaim you Lord of all creation Bringing your kingdom to us now
